lao.definition:
n. a member of a Buddhist people inhabiting the area of the Mekong River in Laos and Thailand and speaking the Lao language; related to the Thais
n. the Tai language of a Buddhist people living in the area of the Mekong River in Thailand and Laos
a. of or relating to a member of the Buddhist people inhabiting the Mekong river in Laos and Thailand

lao people's democratic republic.translation: [网络] 老挝人民民主共和国；寮人民民主共和国；寮国人民民主共和国

lao-tzu.definition: n. Chinese philosopher regarded as the founder of Taoism (6th century BC)
lao-tzu.translation: n. 老子（中国哲学家, 道家的创始人）

lao-zi.translation: [网络] 老子；太上老君点化六诏；李耳

laocoon.definition: n. (Greek mythology) the priest of Apollo who warned the Trojans to beware of Greeks bearing gifts when they wanted to accept the Trojan Horse; a god who favored the Greeks (Poseidon or Athena) sent snakes who coiled around Laocoon and his two twin sons killing them
laocoon.translation: n. 拉奥孔雕像；[希神] 拉奥孔

laodicea.translation: n. 劳迪西亚（叙利亚最大海港拉塔基亚的古名）

laodicean.definition:
a. Of or pertaining to Laodicea, a city in Phrygia Major;
   like the Christians of Laodicea; lukewarm in religion.
laodicean.translation:
a. 老底嘉人的, 冷淡的
n. 冷淡

laoighis.translation: n. 莱锡（爱尔兰一郡名）

laomedon.translation: n. [希神]拉俄墨冬(特洛伊的创建人)

laon.translation: n. 拉翁（印度尼西亚城市名）

laos.definition: n. a mountainous landlocked communist state in southeastern Asia; achieved independence from France in 1949

laotian.definition: a. of or relating to Laos or its people
laotian.translation: n. 老挝的, 老挝人, 老挝语

laotians.definition: n. a member of a Buddhist people inhabiting the area of the Mekong River in Laos and Thailand and speaking the Lao language; related to the Thais
laotians.translation: n. 寮人；老挝人（Laotian的复数）
